# ADR-3074: A07: Credential stuffing without bot controls for login 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Unthrottled logins enable stuffing at scale.

## Decision

Login services SHALL NOT allow credential stuffing without bot controls for login 2 (A07-2).

## Consequences

Bot and velocity controls are mandatory.
